scripts.dev:setup: docker compose up -d --wait mailpit && pnpm --filter @waitron/server dev:setup
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose up -d --wait mailpit && pnpm --filter @waitron/server dev:reset
scripts.dev:onboard: docker compose up -d --wait mailpit && pnpm --filter @waitron/server dev:onboard

scripts.test: vitest run && node scripts/run-with-deadline.mjs 1200 -- pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 test
